description: Pakistan - Demand For Distributed Renewable Energy Generation is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand, Renewable energy", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Task-3 Tail-Ended-Grid Tail Ended Grid Station IESCO with Regards To-Maximum Load, Length of Feeders, KVA Connected, Category-wise consumers with load in (KW), Percentage Losses and specific category consumers. Coverage: Pakistan. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy demand, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
